source_row.rationale: Feraheme (ferumoxytol) carries a boxed warning for serious hypersensitivity and anaphylaxis. The May 31, 2026 label requires administration as an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes with personnel and therapies available to treat anaphylaxis, and observation during and for at least 30 minutes after the infusion.
source_row.source_detail: Updated May 31, 2026; Boxed Warning and section 5.1 Serious Hypersensitivity Reactions: infusion over at least 15 minutes; observe during and at least 30 minutes afterward.
source_row.stem: A client is receiving intravenous ferumoxytol for iron-deficiency anemia. Which safety measure is required by the current product label?
